name: deadrules
description: You have 40 rules in your CLAUDE.md. deadrules removes each one, measures, and tells you which ones actually changed the agent's behaviour.

scripts.images: npm run build && FORCE_COLOR=1 node scripts/example-report.mjs | node scripts/render-svg.mjs --title 'deadrules ablate' --caption 'Illustrative output. The layout is generated by the real reporter; the numbers are not from a real run.' > docs/report.svg && FORCE_COLOR=1 node dist/cli.js rules | node scripts/render-svg.mjs --title 'deadrules rules' --caption "A real run against this repository's own CLAUDE.md. Costs nothing: no agent is invoked." > docs/rules.svg && node scripts/svg-to-png.mjs docs/report.svg docs/report.png && node scripts/svg-to-png.mjs docs/rules.svg docs/rules.png
